title: Connectivity
description: Whether the application should reach the network at all, right now. Two separate questions, deliberately never equated: - state - what the environment appears to provide; - mode - what the application allows. The state is a hint. `navigator.onLine === true` means the host has a network interface, not that a given origin answers; a captive portal, a dead DNS server and a firewalled origin all report as online. Nothing here promises reachability, and code that needs certainty has to try. Connectivity is not cache-specific. It is an ordinary runtime service: UI subscribes to it for an offline banner, and the cache uses it through a CachePolicyResolver rather than reaching into it.

members.name: new
members.description: source is normally the application's PlatformAdapter, which satisfies NetworkHintSource. Omit it to build one over the browser's own signals - which is what lets a Connectivity exist BEFORE an application does, so the same instance can be handed to a ConnectivityPolicyResolver and to ApplicationOptions.connectivity.

members.name: destroy
members.description: Stops listening to the host and clears the signals. A hint source handed in belongs to whoever built it - normally the application's platform adapter, which outlives this - and is left alone; one this instance built for itself is torn down here.

members.name: allowsNetwork
members.description: Whether an acquisition starting now may use the network. 'unknown' counts as permitted: the host is not saying the network is gone, and refusing on no evidence would break every environment that reports nothing.

members.name: mode
members.description: What the application allows. Defaults to 'auto', which follows state. Changing it affects acquisitions that START afterwards. One already in flight keeps the contract it began under: a request that was allowed to reach the network is not retroactively forbidden mid-transfer.

members.name: state
members.description: What the environment appears to provide. A hint from the host, never a promise that any particular origin is reachable.

members.name: onModeChange
members.description: Fires when mode changes, with the new mode.

members.name: onStateChange
members.description: Fires when state changes, with the new state.
